_comment: Upstream changelog entries already triaged, keyed by release, scope and a digest of the entry. The sentences themselves are deliberately not stored: primeng.dev content is outside the MIT grant (CONTRIBUTING.md), so this file records OUR decisions, not their prose. Regenerate with: npm run watch:upstream -- --record

22.1.0 · Table · 9f85f9a516a5.note: Undecided — no reproduction attempted. clear() recomputes totalRecords, but the "after data change" path runs through the _value setter and was not traced. Do not close this by reasoning.

22.1.0 · Table · 3ae212c58d45.note: REPRODUCES, and wider than upstream states it. ButtonProps declares outlined? (types/button/button.types.ts:114) but button.ts never reads buttonProps?.outlined — every other prop uses the `x || buttonProps?.x` pattern. So outlined is ignored on EVERY agl-button, not just this one; the table additionally hard-codes [outlined]="true" on the clear button. Fix changes runtime behaviour: blocked by P3 in Phase 1.

22.1.0 · Table · 0c9d548f166c.note: Undecided — z-index/stacking, not judgeable from source. Needs the browser gate.

22.1.0 · Table · d9c2f7aacdad.note: Mechanism identified, not yet reproduced. clearFilterValues() sets each constraint .value = null IN PLACE and leaves the constraint registered, so hasFilter() stays true and _filter() keeps running. Two consequences: the inputs may not refresh under OnPush (no new reference), and a notEquals constraint then blanks the table — see the api/notEquals entry, which is the same defect meeting a different matcher. Needs a browser test.

22.1.0 · DatePicker · b3d68c790b2d.note: Strong match. The min-time clamp in datepicker.ts (~2716-2740) is a switch(true) with intentional fall-through that hard-codes returnTimeTriple[0] = 11 in two branches. Inherited verbatim from 21.1.9. Exact trigger not yet reproduced.

22.1.0 · Select · fff76133ad6e.note: NOT OURS. angulux select has no `multiple` input — that property exists only in their v22. Nothing here can enter the state described.

22.1.0 · FilterService · 2d7b393e4c46.note: REPRODUCES. Proven at runtime against the BUILT package: FilterService.filter with an empty filter returns 0/3 rows for notEquals and 3/3 for equals/startsWith/contains/notContains (null, undefined and "" alike). filterservice.ts:101-103 returns false where every sibling returns true. dateIsNot delegates to it. Reachable from the UI: executeLocalFilter (table.ts:2142) has no blank guard, and columnFilter registers constraints with value: null. Fix changes runtime behaviour: blocked by P3 in Phase 1.

22.1.0 · Chart · e4168e282a3c.note: DOES NOT REPRODUCE. Type-checked the built dist (chart + table + api) under strict:true, skipLibCheck:false with the workspace TypeScript: exit 0. Their defect is in their v22 types.

22.1.0 · Menu · 1cba7aee156a.note: Not actionable. No locus, no reproduction steps, and their issue tracker is archived. Reopen only if the same shape is reported against angulux.
